description.value:
Your Fusion is even stronger than before! Designate a Metamorian Fusion that you have become, you gain 50 Fusion HP and Fusion Ki for the Duration of that fusion. This Fusion HP and Ki are treated as normal HP and Ki but are not calculated on the fusees when the Metamorian Fusion ends.

You automatically pass any Skill Checks to fuse into the designated Fusion. This Feat can be taken multiple times but can not be used on the same fusion.
